CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2839 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head c287bc54d210d267228ad36f9cea9f08a9eb5753. Bus nonce: f0ad29eca5452b8fe80b1d102ff64f18. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin c287bc54d210d267228ad36f9cea9f08a9eb5753`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge c287bc54d210d267228ad36f9cea9f08a9eb5753` or `Fix review: blocked c287bc54d210d267228ad36f9cea9f08a9eb5753 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: f0ad29eca5452b8fe80b1d102ff64f18`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `c287bc54d210d267228ad36f9cea9f08a9eb5753` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2839 c287bc54d210d267228ad36f9cea9f08a9eb5753") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2839-f0ad29ec`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
FIX REVIEW of #2839 (topic r10-hotfix-ci-ratchet-critpath), a main-red hotfix, head c287bc54d210d267228ad36f9cea9f08a9eb5753, code commit c8c77b82. Review per dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md (origin/main) from a detached worktree at the head SHA.

The change is small: tests/ci_ratchet.py run_minutes now excludes runner queue time, and the critical_path_minutes budget in the ratchet budgets file is lowered from 54.825 to 34.267.

Check, and measure at the head rather than trusting the body:
1. The lowering is honest. Reproduce the recorded figure 34.267 from the run data the body cites, using the same run_minutes definition as the head. Show that excluding runner queue gives that number, and that the old 54.825 was the same measure with queue included. Run the ratchet at the head and report its output.
2. The exclusion does not hide real work. Check what run_minutes now drops, and whether any step the critical path actually executes is misclassified as queue.
3. The carry routing in the body is correct: each carried item goes to the stage named for it, and nothing is silently dismissed. Check the body against the carry rules in fix-review.md.
4. A failing test or mutant proof where the body claims one. Mutate the exclusion and confirm the ratchet fails.
5. The delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2839.md is in the three-dot diff against origin/main. Check the merge with origin/main is clean (git merge-tree --write-tree) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.

Output: write verdict.md in a fresh directory of your own. Its first line is exactly `Fix review: merge c287bc54d210d267228ad36f9cea9f08a9eb5753` or `Fix review: blocked c287bc54d210d267228ad36f9cea9f08a9eb5753`. The next line is `bus-nonce: f0ad29eca5452b8fe80b1d102ff64f18`. Then your findings, each with a severity and a carry. Post the verdict as a comment on PR #2839. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce. Do not name any path under a home directory in the verdict.
